correctness.rationale: The printed generator in Proposition 4.1 was transcribed in order and checked in a separate standard-library replay (branches/ea30aadc-f15f-4bc7-bf7b-d00f6ea67cba/independent_verify.py and replay.txt). Full rank makes U -> UG bijective on subspaces, and a coordinate vanishes on the image precisely when its column is orthogonal to U. Free entries to the right of pivots and outside pivot columns enumerate each RREF basis once. The replay starts from the matrix, confirms rank 6 and Gram determinant 1, matches every support bin and all 56,631 subspaces, and confirms the unique dimension-two RREF and eight zero positions. Nonzero, pairwise nonproportional columns exclude dual weights one and two; all 2,024 triples were rank-tested and exactly the three stated triples have rank two. Each such kernel has two nonzero vectors with full triple support; a fourth collinear point would force at least four dependent triples and is excluded. No frozen script was executed. The companion data row was not independently retrieved; correctness uses the primary printed representative.
